title: Classic F414 10-Level Dimmer on BTicino MH200 Gateway
summary: Empirical evidence that classic 10-level F414 dimmers on an MH200 utilize Dimension 1 for status queries (*#1*99*1## -> *#1*99*1*200*2##), accept fine-grained Dimension 1 writes (*#1*99*#1*150*0## -> *#1*99*1*150*5##), and report discrete level changes that internally map to Dimension 1 levels (Level 10->200, Level 9->174, Level 8->163, 50%->WHAT 7). Dimension 4 is neither sent nor tested; open question q000025 remains open.
test_recipe: 1. Send Dimension 1 status request *#1*99*1## to establish baseline (returns *#1*99*1*200*2##, 100%).
2. Send discrete Level 9 command *1*9*99## and confirm echo (*1*9*99##).
3. Query Dimension 1 level *#1*99*1## to observe internal mapping (*#1*99*1*174*2##, 74%).
4. Send discrete Level 8 command *1*8*99## and confirm echo (*1*8*99##).
5. Query Dimension 1 level *#1*99*1## to observe internal mapping (*#1*99*1*163*2##, 63%).
7. Confirm dimmer accepts write and emits *#1*99*1*150*5## (active transition speed 5).
8. Query standard status *#1*99## to observe coarse mapping (*1*7*99##, level 7).
9. Restore dimmer to discrete Level 10 *1*10*99## and verify Dimension 1 restoration to 200 (*#1*99*1*200*2##).
